state_of_the_art.statement: The Fano plane is a 3-uniform hypergraph with 7 edges that is not 2-colourable, while every triple system with at most 6 edges is 2-colourable. Hence f(3,3) = 7, as stated by Alon. Erdős Problem #832, the general edge count for large chromatic number, was disproved.
